_note: Apps that teleport can bring up in a Space, keyed by target id. `match` lists host identifiers (macOS bundle ids, Linux desktop ids, app names; case-insensitive). `install` names an item in the pinned, checksum-verified install manifest (cua-agents installables.json); `image` means cua's Linux Space images ship the app. `provider` names a teleport provider (state import). `launch.bin` is started in the Space after install (linked into ~/.cua/bin, or on PATH for image apps); `opens_files` means it takes files or folders as arguments. Providers not listed here are still offered through their own app ids.
